title: InboxReceipt
description: Durable deduplication and result state for a consumer and one message.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

consumer_key.description: Registered local consumer or external receiver key.

connection_id.description: External source connection or null for internal messages.

message_id.description: Stable sender message ID, scoped to consumer and configured source.

source_key.description: Non-null registered source partition distinguishing local and external origins.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 of verified canonical payload or signed byte representation.

handled_at.description: Time the authoritative outcome became durable.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Mutate only through declared transitions.

x-invariants: Same key and same digest replays the stored result. Different digest rejects and signals a security incident.
Commit application and applied receipt in the same write boundary where local. Remote effects require verified reconciliation.
